Messages.Author: Rob LeGood
Messages.Body:
Sounds like a great idea!

An interesting feature might be to profile new card ideas. (Give
something to WOTC to think about). To start the ball rolling, I'll give
mine.

My favorite decks are political, in nature, so this is something I had
thought of a while ago. For this idea, most Clans would have thier own
version of the card.

<Clan> Domination
{Master} - 0 pool
While <Clan> Domination is in play, all <Clan> Vampires recieve 1 extra
vote during any political action. If any other Domination card is
brought into play during the game, immediatly burn this card.

Any thoghts or other card ideas?

rob.

> vote during any political action. If any other Domination card is
> brought into play during the game, immediatly burn this card.

Having a card-restricted set of means to remove this sort of effect
is not sufficient to reduce its cost to zero.

Either make the card cost 2 pool (a la the much-more-easily burned
Ventrue Directorate Assembly),

or have it (also) burnable as a +1 stealth (D) action.

or have it cost 1 pool and have it (also) burnable as a vote

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Sorrow (cbo...@apdi.net) wrote:

: Sport Bike & Tabloid Newspaper both grant +1 intercept, both affect only 1
: minion and both only cost 1 pool.
: Anything granting the converse (+1 stealth) affecting only 1 minion, should
: also cost only 1 pool.
: Sorrow

Not sure I agree. It might be better to compare to other permanent
stealth cards, like Backways or the Labyrinth. These both cost 1 pool and
effect only 1 minion, but they also have disadvantages: They are unique,
and they only effect one particular clan. They also cost a master phase
action instead of a minion phase action to bring into play, and master
phase actions are sometimes considered more valuable.

Tabloid Newspaper is a poor example, since it requires the minion to burn
a blood each time to gain the intercept. This is the price paid for
having one less pool cost than KRCG News Radio, which does the same thing
without that disadvantage.

John W.

Messages.Author: The Corrupter
Messages.Body:
On 21 Feb 1997, Sorrow wrote:

> > Black Limousine
> > 2 pool
> > equipment
> > vehicle
> > Minion with this equipment gets
> > +1 stealth on all of her actions.
> > No minion may have more than one
> > vehicle at a time.

> 2 pool?
> No way, should only be 1 since it only affects one minion.
> Sport Bike & Tabloid Newspaper both grant +1 intercept, both affect only 1
> minion and both only cost 1 pool.
> Anything granting the converse (+1 stealth) affecting only 1 minion, should
> also cost only 1 pool.

Not true. Stealth is more powerful than intercept.

A minion with a base of 1 stealth will be unblocked by any minion that
doesn't have intercept. This means, without further modifications on
either side, a previously unsuccessful action would now be successful.

A minion with intercept, on the other hand, in a similar situation will
have a previously unsuccessful action against it now be again
unsuccessful. Whereas intercept is only useful if someone is using
stealth, stealth is useful whether or not they play intercept.

> minion and both only cost 1 pool.
> Anything granting the converse (+1 stealth) affecting only 1 minion, should
> also cost only 1 pool.

Not so. Stealth is more powerful than intercept.

This is why retainers that give intercept are free, while
retainers that give only limited-use stealth cost 2 blood.
(Mr. Winthrop vs. Marijava Ghoul. One of the blood cost
might be to balance the extra life and non-uniqueness that
the Ghoul has. The other is to balance the fact that she
bestows stealth, albeit only on a selected subset of actions).

And why KRCG is clanless in both control and effect, while
locations that give stealth to non-stealthy clans are
much more restrictive while costing the same.

One thing that the game does not need more of is global-use stealth.

Messages.Body:
In our playgroup, we've been tossing around the idea of something to monkey with the impossible-to-touch-without-a-well-timed-Sudden-Reversal Short Term and Protracted Investment cards.

The card we've been thinking of most often is:

Stock Market Crash
Master
1 or 2 pool cost.
Burn all Investments in play, and all blood on them. Only one Stock Market Crash may be played in a game.

Another related card was:

Insider Trader
Retainer (or ally)
2 blood (or 2 pool)
(1 life, 1 hand dam, 1 bleed? or 0 bleed?)
The vampire with this retainer (or this ally) may take a +1 (D) action to steal one blood from an investment, and put that blood in its controller's blood bool.

What do you think? Is it wrong to mess with the sanctity of the investments? What do you think of the balance of the effects?

Bullfrog

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
jerb...@aol.com wrote:
>
> In our playgroup, we've been tossing around the idea of something to monkey with the impossible-to-touch-without-a-well-timed-Sudden-Reversal Short Term and Protracted Investment cards.
>

Cards that are impossible to touch without a SR, are slow in effect,
won't often swing the game one way or another, and generally are
balanced when looking at their cost. If Investments were now subject to
destruction or theft then they could possibly be considered overcosted
for their benefit. In short, I think this is a bad idea.

Robert
